subject: Setting plotting character when 'shape' aesthetic controlled by  variable?

messages.author: 4ba5978dde56df06
messages.subject: Setting plotting character when 'shape' aesthetic controlled by  variable?
parts:
Dear group,

Given the following example:

dat <- data.frame(X = runif(10), Y = runif(10),
Abund = rbeta(10, 2, 5),
Group = factor(sample(1:3, 10, rep = TRUE)))
head(dat)

p <- ggplot(dat, aes(X, Y, size = Abund, shape = Group)) +
geom_point()
p

How do I change the plotting characters to be anything other than the
defaults?

Many thanks,

Gavin
